# Romantic Orientation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:RomanticOrientation`](gmeow-RomanticOrientation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/RomanticOrientation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sexuality`](../../slices/sexuality.md)

A person's SELF-ASSERTED romantic orientation — the pattern of their romantic attraction — as a reified facet pointing (via [`gmeow:romanticOrientationValue`](../properties/gmeow-romanticOrientationValue.md)) to an open [`gmeow:RomanticOrientationValue`](gmeow-RomanticOrientationValue.md). A SEPARATE axis from sexual orientation (split-attraction model); the two are mutually independent (e.g. asexual yet biromantic).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:IdentityFacet`](gmeow-IdentityFacet.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:RomanticOrientation`](gmeow-RomanticOrientation.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:IdentityFacet`](gmeow-IdentityFacet.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
